caption: Dutch Reformed Church, Oranjestad
composition: Roofless stone nave and three-storey tower on Kerkweg · AI-generated artistic interpretation
description: The Dutch Reformed Church in Oranjestad is a stone ruin. The nave has stood open to the sky since the roof was lost in 1792, and a three-storey tower stands at the northwest corner. It is clear, about 29.2°C, with wind near 21.5 km/h and cloud cover about 0%. The tower repair of about 2019 is finished, so no scaffold is shown. Fort Oranje and Lower Town are other scenes and are not this frame.
